  • Constructor Details

    • MatchManager

      public MatchManager(LobbyReadyListener onReady, ServerNotifier notifier, HybridServerNetworkAdapter hybrid)
      Creates a match manager responsible for lobby lifecycle, active matches, and nickname reservation across all game sessions.
      Parameters:
      onReady - listener notified when a lobby becomes ready to start
      notifier - notifier used to send events to connected clients
      hybrid - hybrid adapter used for player-to-game routing and cleanup

  • Method Details

    • createLobby

      public String createLobby(String nickname, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new lobby, reserves the creator's nickname, and registers the first player in the newly created session.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player creating the lobby
      numPlayers - the number of players required to start the game
      Returns:
      the generated game session ID

    • joinLobby

      public void joinLobby(String nickname, String gameID) throws Exception
      Registers a player into an existing lobby after validating the lobby state and reserving the player's nickname globally.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the joining player
      gameID - the identifier of the lobby to join
      Throws:
      Exception - if the lobby is invalid, already started, the nickname is taken, or player registration fails

    • onLobbyReady

      public void onLobbyReady(String gameID, ServerController serverController)
      Moves a ready lobby into the active games registry and starts its dedicated server-controller thread.
      Parameters:
      gameID - the identifier of the ready game session
      serverController - the controller managing the started match

    • onGameOver

      public void onGameOver(String gameID)
      Cleans up the registries associated with a completed game session and releases the nicknames of all participating players.
      Parameters:
      gameID - the identifier of the completed game session

    • abortGame

      public void abortGame(String gameID, String reason, String disconnectedNickname)
      Aborts a lobby or a running game session, notifies the remaining players when possible, and releases all associated shared state such as nicknames, mappings, and threads.
      Parameters:
      gameID - the identifier of the session to abort
      reason - the reason for the abort
      disconnectedNickname - the nickname of the player that triggered the abort, or null if not applicable
